critical_code_review_comments: apps/api/app/services/inventory.py:197-219 — CLOSED gate is now the ONLY code path controlling reopen semantics. It computes payload_keys = {k for k,v in data.items() if v is not None} and requires payload_keys == {'status'} AND target_status != CLOSED. Correct: {status:active,name:'x'} yields payload_keys={'status','name'} ≠ {'status'} → 409. Two-step flow is enforced structurally, not by convention.

detail.submitted_fields is sorted(payload_keys) — deterministic, alphabetical, safe for test assertions. Verified live: {status,name} returns ['name','status']; {status,address} returns ['address','status']; {name} returns ['name'].

Null-value keys are correctly excluded from payload_keys (line 198) — so a caller who sends {status:'active', name: null} is treated as {status:'active'} and permitted to reopen. This matches Pydantic exclude_none/optional semantics on WarehouseUpdate.

No partial application on refusal: HTTPException is raised BEFORE the setattr loop at line 220, so the aborted PATCH leaves the warehouse untouched. Verified live: after {status:'active', address:'12 New Rd'} refusal, GET returns status='closed' and address=null.
endpoint apps/api/app/api/v1/endpoints/inventory.py:update_warehouse remains a thin delegate to the service — no endpoint-local conditionals, per user directive. Correct.

rca of the issue: N/A — verification pass confirms the fix. RCA of the underlying iter7 defect (for archival): the previous update_warehouse() reopen branch allowed the caller to include arbitrary non-status fields alongside {status:'active'}, silently applying them because the CLOSED guard's early-exit condition matched only on status presence, not on payload cardinality. The iter8 fix replaces `if 'status' in data ...` with `if payload_keys == {'status'} and target_status != CLOSED`, converting reopen into a set-equality check so any accompanying key trips the 409. Reproduction steps (now blocked): (1) PATCH wh with {status:'closed'} → 200; (2) PATCH wh with {status:'active', name:'x'} → previously 200 + rename applied, now 409 warehouse_closed_no_writes with submitted_fields=['name','status'].
